name: File upload
purpose: Document journeys: a dashed dropzone (drag-and-drop or browse) staging files into rows with per-file determinate progress, outcome roundels, ink error messages and a 24px remove control. Nothing auto-submits. Itinerary row 18 (P1); built Phase-2 wave 2 (worker A continuation).

props.name: accept
props.$note: Mirrored in the help line — 'PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10MB each.' (constraints stated up front, 3.3.2).

props.name: maxSize
props.$note: Oversize files stage as error rows with a suggestive message — never silently dropped (3.3.1/3.3.3).

props.name: multiple
props.$note: Single-file journeys set false; the zone copy stays plural-neutral.

variants.name: resting
variants.use: 1px dashed form/border/default zone, upload glyph, browse = Mono secondary.

variants.name: drag-over
variants.use: Solid form/border/active + hover fill — same field-chrome tokens, no new colours.

tokens.zone: form/border/default dashed → form/border/active + form/background/hover on drag-over
tokens.progress: track = form/background/hover, fill = text/default INK — progress is STRUCTURE, not status (R-D22 spirit); no determinate indicator existed anywhere in the library (Loading-indicator is spinner-only; loader atom queued, NOT minted here)
tokens.outcome: rag/success + rag/error roundels (R-D20); message text stays text/default
tokens.motion: component-type/button-family/press-travel + press-darken (B-D7) on browse + remove — injection pending conductor registration

behaviour.staging: Drop or browse stages files (acd-019: nothing auto-submits); each valid file simulates upload with a determinate bar (aria-valuenow updates), then swaps to the success roundel. Oversize files stage as error rows immediately.
behaviour.remove: Per-row 24px close (36px extended hit target); removal announced via the polite live region.
behaviour.announcements: Added / uploading / uploaded / could-not-add / removed all pass through one aria-live region (4.1.3).

accessibility.structure: Real <label for> on the hidden file input; the browse button proxies its click; constraints in help text joined via aria-describedby; rows in a labelled list.
accessibility.progress: role=progressbar with aria-valuenow/min/max + per-file aria-label; completion swaps to a roundel + sr-only 'Uploaded'.
accessibility.colour: Error/success roundels are never the only channel — messages stay ink, announcements name the file (1.4.1). Dark roundels follow the WHITE-shape policy.
accessibility.keyboard: Browse is a real button; drag-and-drop always has the browse equivalent (2.1.1); remove buttons are labelled per file.
accessibility.$note: 3.2.2 met (staging only, no auto-submit) but out of relatedSC: not in the compliance lookup (Form-layout precedent).

antiPatterns: Drag-and-drop as the ONLY path (keyboard/AT users need the browse button — 2.1.1).
Auto-submitting on file choice (staging only; submission belongs to the form's action bar).
Silently rejecting oversize/wrong-type files (stage an error row and say why + what to do).
A spinner instead of the determinate bar (upload progress is knowable — show it; the loader atom is queued for indeterminate states).
Green/red progress fills (progress is structure = ink; colour arrives with the outcome).
Local press-physics CSS on browse/remove (ADR-0013: injected partial only).

tokenValidation.result: PASS — new build, no deprecated tokens: zone/field chrome = live form/* set, outcomes = R-D20 rag pair, browse = button/secondary/* ladder, radius = control role, motion = component-type/button-family params (values byte-identical to Button's blocks).
tokenValidation.$note: Progress bar uses existing roles only (form/background/hover + text/default) — no bar tokens minted; flagged as accretion evidence if other lanes need determinate bars.
